text:
nora: Quick sync for tomorrow's benchmark post + press wave. Embargo lift set for 08:00 PT. Need final press pack link, CEO one-liner, and a contingency if numbers shift.
tia: Press pack uploaded: https://redwood.docs/press/bench-nov.zip. Methodology section updated and QA'd.
devin: Social + paid schedule draft: 08:00 blog live, 08:05 tiered outreach, 08:10 CEO quote post, 08:30 short explainer clip, paid starts +20m. Hold paid if any corrections.
lucas: Streaming not needed for this publish but ops on standby if we pivot. CDN cache purge scheduled after final upload.
legal_bot: Reminder: raw run-level data requires NDA. Any reporter requests for underlying CSVs must be routed to legal for review. Also, avoid absolute performance guarantees in the CEO quote.
pressbot: Outreach will queue at 08:05 PT to tier-1 then tier-2 at +5m. I can hold sends if you give a hold token.
nora: Two asks: 1) Nora needs a 1-line safe opener for CEO (no absolutes). 2) A fallback headline in case a top-line number moves on late rounding.
tia: Draft CEO opener: "Today we publish an updated inference benchmark and accompanying tooling; see methodology for details." Safe?
legal_bot: Good, replace "tooling" with "tools and guidance" to be slightly broader.
devin: Fallback headlines pinned in pack: "Redwood releases updated inference benchmark and tools" OR "Redwood releases benchmark; methodology clarified". Picking the first unless numbers change.
nora: Good. Lucas, confirm CDN purge time and that old press pack links are invalidated.
lucas: Purge scheduled for 07:40 PT. I will rotate signed URLs for press assets at purge time to avoid old link leakage.
pressbot: Holding outreach until 08:05 PT per schedule. Will wait for final confirm here at 07:50 PT.
nora: Team owners: Tia (press pack finalization & press DM triage), Devin (social + paid), Lucas (CDN + assets), Legal_bot (sign-off). React with :thumbsup: if you own it.
tia: :thumbsup:
devin: :thumbsup:
lucas: :thumbsup:
pressbot: Reminder scheduled for 07:50 PT and 08:00 PT.
nora: One more: if a reporter asks for raw CSVs before NDA, respond with "we can share redacted aggregates publicly; raw runs available under NDA—please send requests to press@redwood and we'll coordinate." Pin that line in the pack.
legal_bot: Confirmed. Also add a short FAQ entry for reporters about what we can and cannot share; pinned to the pack.
nora: OK locking this thread for final confirm. If nothing changes, I will post approve_send token at 07:50 PT. Keep monitoring and escalate anything urgent to me.
pressbot: Acknowledge. Standing by for approve_send token.
